bio: Fourth-year S1 Informatika student at Telkom University, working across two areas. In medical imaging: automated bone scan diagnosis published in Knowledge-Based Systems, and a five-module chest X-ray platform shipping as web and desktop apps. In industrial AI: a fatigue detection model running on live mining fleet dashcams, and provider-aware retrieval for B2B travel inventory that won the Travlr Data Challenge. Three published papers, three more accepted at IEEE conferences this year. GPA 4.0/4.0. Graduating 2027.
